description:
User-approved 2026-11-25: one P1 covering three reports of the same symptom. On interp the failure is "backend dispatch callsite … missed an exhaustive dispatch"; native gets SIGILL (exit 132). A suspected common cause, a dispatch plan judged exhaustive with no last resort, is unconfirmed. Trace all three. Any case that turns out to have a different cause splits back out as its own ticket (propose it).

Case 1 (Elixir Parity; blocks fz-mue.68, and through it fz-nhb.15 defguard and #791). Reproduced on 66bfc7f89 and 06a361f53. Repro: fz-otp-json/probes/mue68/u2.fz.
  def walk({form, meta, args}, fun) when is_atom(form), do: fun.({form, meta, walk_args(args, fun)})
  def walk(x, fun), do: fun.(x)
  defp walk_args(args, _fun) when is_atom(args), do: args
  defp walk_args(args, fun) when is_list(args), do: :lists.map(fn x -> walk(x, fun) end, args)
  walk({:+, [], [5, 3]}, fn x -> x end); walk({:+, [], [5, 3]}, &id/1)
Elixir prints {:+, [], [5, 3]} twice. fz run prints nothing and exits 132. interp: missed an exhaustive dispatch (ExecutableKey FunctionId(94), need: Value). A single call works. Macro.postwalk followed by a second postwalk with a different callable crashes the same way.

Case 2 (folded from fz-mue.74, Elixir Parity). for v <- [1,2] do try do if v == 1, do: v, else: raise("x") catch k, r -> {k, r} end end. interp: missed an exhaustive dispatch; native: SIGILL. Works inside a named function. Repro: Elixir Parity's scratchpad walk791/p1.fz.

Case 3 (Bugs and Cleanup, from fz-sc8.256's investigation, scratchpad s256/findings.md). default = if flag, do: {:a, 1}, else: {:k}; Enum.map([1], fn r -> {default, r} end) gives missed an exhaustive dispatch. Not fixed by the sc8.256 fix; a different site.

Done when: all three repros match Elixir on interp, run and build as oracle fixtures, and the dispatch cannot be judged exhaustive without covering every value that reaches it.
title: A dispatch judged exhaustive matches every value that reaches it
